scopeLabel: Independent scoped audit: matched main pp.1–2 and SI pp.1–11, main Figures 1–3/Table 1 and SI Figures S1–S7. Upstream cited methods remain outside this package.

sourceAudit.scope: Complete locally matched main pp.1–2 and SI pp.1–11 for packaged methods, products and figures.

conflictPairs.text: Main p.1 gives nominal Cd2+ concentration 0.025 M and AgNO3 0.15 M, a sixfold numerical ratio, while SI p.3 calls 0.15 M AgNO3 '5 times the nominal Cd2+ concentration'. Preserve both published statements; do not repair the ratio silently.
Main p.1 waits 12 h after adding Ag+ before methanol wash; SI p.3 says Ag2Se wet gel develops after 'a few hours'. These are distinct described endpoints and are both retained.
The text layer misrecognizes α-Ag2Se as R-Ag2Se. Original PDF page rendering visually confirms Greek α in main p.1–2.
Main Figure 2 insets are reference crystal diagrams; they are not measured atomic structures of the pictured aerogels.
SI contents p.1 calls Figure S4 porosimetry of CdSe and Ag2Se, but actual Figure S4 caption/plot on p.8 shows Ag2Se only; no CdSe S4 curve is assigned.

general_background.title: Changing cations in an existing solid
general_background.summary: Cation exchange changes the cation population of an existing material while transport and interface motion govern the transformation. Retention of an anion framework or particle shape depends on the particular system.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Forging Colloidal Nanostructures via Cation Exchange Reactions

general_background.title: Conversion of a nonmetal precursor
general_background.summary: Chalcogen and pnictogen precursors can differ in how they release or transfer the element during a reaction. Bonding, coordination and the reaction medium can influence the activation or transfer steps that make an element available for growth.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Prospects of Colloidal Nanocrystals for Electronic and Optoelectronic Applications
